posts.title: Field research & guest lectures at Ubon Ratchathani University, Thailand
posts.snippet: Honoured to conclude our international academic collaboration at Ubon Ratchathani University. Across eight lecture sessions and an international symposium, we explored how India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission and Thailand’s Bio-Circular-Green (BCG) model can create mutually reinforcing energy pathways across the Bay of Bengal.
posts.author: Soumyajit Mukherjee

posts.title: Synthesising multi-agency agricultural intelligence at World Agriculture Forum
posts.snippet: Wrapping up my research & knowledge management engagement with the World Agriculture Forum in Amsterdam. Distilling ten multilateral reports into clear executive briefs underscored one thing: climate adaptation in agriculture requires transforming raw agronomic data into compelling, human-centered narratives that policymakers can immediately act upon.
posts.author: Soumyajit Mukherjee

posts.title: Water stewardship & SDG 16 with UN Global Compact Network India
posts.snippet: Privileged to contribute to the UN Global Compact Network India’s initiatives in New Delhi. Collaborating on the design of the national water-quality assessment report with UNDP and Bayer allowed us to bridge empirical environmental metrics with transparent corporate governance principles.
posts.author: Soumyajit Mukherjee

posts.title: From cinematic look development to sustainable systems design
posts.snippet: Reflecting on the journey from LookDev at DNEG and MPC (working across Furiosa and Sonic 2) to sustainable development management at Nalanda University. The core discipline remains unchanged: understanding materials, lighting, systems, and how subtle details influence human perception.
posts.author: Soumyajit Mukherjee
